text:
maria (Marketing): Quick ask 11 Need a compact benchmark one-pager we can reuse as: webinar hero, email header, and a paid social tile. Requirements: very low copy (headline + 1-line sub), two messaging variants (latency-first and cost-first), and a tiny sparkline comparing tokens/sec vs $/k tokens. Deadline: EOD Wednesday.

jasper (Design): got it. confirm export sizes + formats. svg preferred for brand, plus pngs. mobile and desktop crops?

maria (Marketing): desktop hero 1200x600, mobile crop 640x360, social square 800x800. Provide svg + png (2x). Include responsive crop guides on a single artboard.

liam (Growth): Audience split for variants: dev-first (latency + SDK plug-ins) CTA: "Try the benchmark"; buyer-first (cost + SLAs) CTA: "See pricing & commits". Also we need a no-CTA brand-only variant for lift tests.

jasper (Design): will do two layout approaches: "metric-forward" (big stat + sparkline) and "narrative-forward" (short sentence + stat). Do we have canonical short stats?

maria (Marketing): pull from the latest sheet named "November-inbound-bench v3". Use conservative metrics (median / typical). Headlines 6-10 words, subheads 12-18 words max.

olivia (Legal): small compliance note: avoid absolutes like "cheapest" or "always". Use "up to" or "on typical workloads". Add a tiny methodology footnote and link. I'll review final copy.

jasper (Design): timeline: mockups by tomorrow noon, review at 12:30, final assets EOD Wed. Planning deliverables: 2 layouts x 2 headlines x 2 colorways (brand blue + inverted dark) x 3 crops + micro-GIF for sparkline, README, fig link.

maria (Marketing): please include two headline options per layout and two subhead options so we can A/B both. Also add a small legal-safe badge area (for "SLA-ready" or "Dedicated option") that we can toggle.

jasper (Design): will add a modular badge slot. GIF plan: 3-frame micro-animation for sparkline (export as 320x80 gif). Assets-bot will handle uploads.

assets-bot: mock_v1 package uploaded to /Shared/marketing/mini-bench/mock_v1.zip (contains fig, exports, README).

liam (Growth): also request a PNG with transparent background for media buy overlay. And a copy-only text file with approved short CTAs.

jasper (Design): noted. transparent PNG included. I'll attach a small copy slate file with approved CTAs and the methodology footnote.

maria (Marketing): Olivia, once mock is final can you do legal passthrough? Short copy should be fast to review.

olivia (Legal): yes ping me in thread once final copy is attached. I can turn around in ~1 hour for short claims.

jasper (Design): Figma draft uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/ef12gh34/mini-bench-hero-drafts. Permissions: org-wide. Export slices planned: hero-desktop_1200x600.png/svg, hero-mobile_640x360.png/svg, social_800x800.png/svg, sparkline_320x80.gif.

maria (Marketing): great. I'll post the review checklist in the doc and tag reviewers. Thanks team!

jasper (Design): will ping when mock v2 is ready for review. :sparkles:
